# Source and use

`SKILL.md` includes the complete instruction bodies of Cursor's MIT-licensed `cursor-team-kit` skills from cached revision `ecc249f1e306fc64ddf83c7bed16cacf7c2239db`:

- [`skills/deslop/SKILL.md`](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/blob/ecc249f1e306fc64ddf83c7bed16cacf7c2239db/cursor-team-kit/skills/deslop/SKILL.md)
- [`skills/thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review/SKILL.md`](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/blob/ecc249f1e306fc64ddf83c7bed16cacf7c2239db/cursor-team-kit/skills/thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review/SKILL.md)

Only their discovery frontmatter is omitted; the instruction text is unchanged. Both bodies are embedded directly in the main skill file, with no separate skill dependency.

Copyright (c) 2026 Cursor. The [upstream license](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/blob/ecc249f1e306fc64ddf83c7bed16cacf7c2239db/cursor-team-kit/LICENSE)
is included in [LICENSE.cursor-team-kit](LICENSE.cursor-team-kit) and must
accompany redistribution.

This workflow applies the embedded instructions as a review: editing instructions become proposed findings, the diff uses the PR's actual base, and repository contracts and the user's inline-comment and publication preferences remain in force.

GitHub label selection, stack analysis, CI/specification checks, preview/post modes, deduplication, commit validation, artifacts and publication mechanics are additions for this workflow. Neither Cursor nor an external plugin installation is required.
